bug_summary: __call__を持つクラス自体(インスタンスでなく)を依存関係に使った場合、クラスなのに__call__のasync/generator判定が誤って適用され依存解決が不正になる
pr_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
index 6c4bf18b3..af168a177 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
@@ -110,8 +110,6 @@ class Dependant:
             _impartial(self.call)
         ) or inspect.isgeneratorfunction(_unwrapped_call(self.call)):
             return True
-        if inspect.isclass(_unwrapped_call(self.call)):
-            return False
         dunder_call = getattr(_impartial(self.call), "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         if dunder_call is None:
             return False  # pragma: no cover
@@ -136,8 +134,6 @@ class Dependant:
             _impartial(self.call)
         ) or inspect.isasyncgenfunction(_unwrapped_call(self.call)):
             return True
-        if inspect.isclass(_unwrapped_call(self.call)):
-            return False
         dunder_call = getattr(_impartial(self.call), "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         if dunder_call is None:
             return False  # pragma: no cover
@@ -166,8 +162,6 @@ class Dependant:
             _unwrapped_call(self.call)
         ):
             return True
-        if inspect.isclass(_unwrapped_call(self.call)):
-            return False
         dunder_call = getattr(_impartial(self.call), "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         if dunder_call is None:
             return False  # pragma: no cover
@@ -182,6 +176,7 @@ class Dependant:
             _impartial(dunder_unwrapped_call)
         ) or iscoroutinefunction(_unwrapped_call(dunder_unwrapped_call)):
             return True
+        # if inspect.isclass(self.call): False, covered by default return
         return False

pr_description: The is_coroutine/is_async_gen_callable/is_gen_callable checks on `Dependant` each had an early `inspect.isclass` short-circuit ahead of the `__call__` lookup. Consolidates this to rely on the existing `dunder_call` fallback, which already returns `False` when there's no `__call__` to inspect, removing the duplicated class check across the three properties.
